args.author: agent:long-lived-fly
args.body: a STATE resolves at each of the four declared stages, and the track is NOT MONOTONIC: egg 1e-8 kg / 0.0005 m, larva 0.0000015 kg / 0.0045 m, pupa 0.0000012 kg / 0.003 m, adult 0.000001 kg / 0.0025 m. The larva is heavier and longer than the adult it becomes, so a growth curve for this animal goes up and then down. Every value carries kind "assumed (declared by the design)" -- declared, not measured -- and nothing here simulates the transition between any two of them.

detail.what_it_is_not: Four declared masses at four declared ages. No cell divides, no imaginal disc forms, and the only Lean law about time (genotype-developmental-ordering) certifies that a declared ordering is acyclic -- it does not supply one.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
